about_the_game:
**Game will not be released on Steam. It is available on the Google Play Store for Android devices...

Operation: A.S.S. Takedown is a cozy 2D side scrolling roguelike cute em up. You take on the role of an intern at Weather & Air Productions(WAP) as you attempt to take down weather balloons set up by rival company Atmospheric System Services(ASS).

Through 6 levels with increasing difficulty you'll shoot down enemy clouds, dodge incoming projectiles, and take down opposing bosses. Each run will take around 20 min to complete and your score will be recorded to encourage multiple plays. With roguelike elements such as random enemy locations and permadeath, every run will offer a new and exciting experience.

Need a break from the longer levels? A boss rush mode is available to take on all 6 bosses in rapid succession. Test your skills and see how fast you can defeat the upper brass at A.S.S.

Easy controls and cozy vibes make Operation: A.S.S. Takedown the perfect game for newcomers to the shoot em up genre and experts alike. 

Based on the Weather & Air Productions graphic novel series from Brian Heier and Eric Camp. Book 1 now available on Amazon. Also featuring music from Eric Square and voice work from Twitch streamer/YouTuber, BaerTaffy.
